pages.name: Zlydeny
pages.text: Almost like a Hukha, but it waits for the right moment to strike.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: Lives among hukhas. It shadows you from five to ten blocks away. When you come closer it $(thing)freezes for a second$(), then bites and runs, only to return later.

pages.title: How to fight back
pages.text: $(li)$(#2E7D4F)A tamed Hukha$() attacks the Zlydeny; it flees.$(li)$(#7952A6)Mavkas$() attack it too.$(li)$(#7952A6)The freeze$() is your window: strike first.
